items.stem: What does a service control policy (SCP) do in AWS Organizations?

options.text: Sets the maximum permissions (a guardrail) for accounts, without granting access
options.rationale: Correct: SCPs define the permission ceiling; IAM still grants actual access.

options.text: Grants IAM permissions directly to users
options.rationale: SCPs limit permissions; they do not grant them.

options.text: Replaces the need for IAM policies
options.rationale: IAM policies are still required to grant access within the SCP ceiling.
SCPs govern permissions, not billing allocation.

items.explanation: Correct: an SCP sets the permission ceiling and does not itself grant access.

items.stem: Which TWO are benefits of a governed multi-account setup with Control Tower? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Centralized logging to a dedicated log-archive account
options.rationale: Correct: Control Tower centralizes audit logs for the organization.

options.text: Consistent guardrails applied across enrolled accounts
options.rationale: Correct: guardrails enforce baseline governance across accounts.

options.text: A single shared root user for all teams
options.rationale: Sharing a root user is an anti-pattern, not a benefit.

options.text: Eliminating the need for any IAM controls
options.rationale: IAM is still required within each account.

items.explanation: Correct: centralized logging and consistent guardrails are core Control Tower benefits.

items.stem: How should user access be managed across many AWS accounts?

options.text: Centralize with IAM Identity Center and federation
options.rationale: Correct: Identity Center centralizes access instead of per-account users.

options.text: Create separate IAM users in every account
options.rationale: Per-account users are hard to manage and audit at scale.

options.text: Share one access key across all accounts
options.rationale: Sharing keys is insecure and unauditable.

options.text: Use the management account root for daily work
options.rationale: Root should not be used for daily operations.

items.explanation: Correct: IAM Identity Center centralizes multi-account access.
